initialize

	counts := Dictionary new

add: aWord
	counts at: aWord put: (counts at: aWord ifAbsent: [ 0 ]) + 1

target_methods.source:
wordsAtLeast: aLimitA
	"Words seen at least aLimitA times, in alphabetical order."
	^ ((counts associations select: [ :each | each value >= aLimitA ]) collect: [ :each | each key ]) sorted
